data.narrative:
Western Chemicals is a pre-seed stage climate and energy company founded by Jared West (Columbia B.S. Physics and Mechanical Engineering, '20), which has raised $175K to date. The sector peer universe consists of one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable valuation method given data constraints. Using total capital raised ($175K) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a standard 2.5x step-up multiplier from pre-seed to the subsequent financing stage yields an implied post-money valuation of $438K. Peer-median analysis was not applicable; while eight climate and energy peers exist in the dataset, none met the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables, and an all-sector median would lack meaningful specificity.

The triangulated valuation range is $372K to $503K (median $438K), derived from a single method. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow stage-specific peer benchmarks and reliance on historical stage-progression multipliers that may not capture Western Chemicals' specific risk profile or market conditions. The range should be treated as directional; validation through technical due diligence on the underlying chemistry and commercial pathway will be essential before commitment.
